using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

const ll MOD = 1000000007;
const ll INF = 0x7fffffff;
const int MAX_LEN = 17;

ll p[MAX_LEN];
ll n;

ll solve(ll n_val, int len) {
    if (len == 0) return 0;
    ll base = p[len];
    ll quotient = n_val / base;
    ll remainder = n_val % base;
    ll cost1 = quotient * len;
    if (remainder == 0) {
        return cost1;
    }
    ll cost2 = solve(remainder, len - 1);
    ll cost3 = len + solve(base - remainder, len - 1);
    return cost1 + min(cost2, cost3);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    p[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAX_LEN; ++i) {
        p[i] = p[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n, MAX_LEN - 1) << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
